observations.body: Once each year the high priest enters with blood, sends away the live goat bearing confessed sins, and cleanses the sanctuary and people.
observations.label: Atonement reaches sanctuary, priests, people, and camp

observations.body: The passage presents restricted entry, incense, blood, two goats, confession, removal, cleansing, and rest as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: restricted entry, incense, blood, two goats, confession, removal, cleansing, and rest

observations.body: The passage places day of atonement beside restricted entry, incense, blood, two goats, confession, removal, cleansing, and rest.
observations.label: day of atonement

payload.posture: Read Leviticus 16:1–34 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the two goats perform different actions and should not be merged into one animal’s movement
